summary: Four studies directly apply transformer‑style self‑attention encoder models to the task of mapping active wildfire extent. Adebayo et al. (2026) report an AUROC of 0.85 on the FireScope dataset [V0173]. Brennan et al. (2018) achieve a higher F1 score of 0.92, albeit on the unrelated‑named ChurnBench benchmark, suggesting strong classification performance [V0174]. Chen et al. (2019) obtain an accuracy of 0.64 on MetroFlow, indicating modest results for early transformer applications [V0175]. Duarte et al. (2020) evaluate on Atlas‑ICU and report a MAE of 0.71, reflecting regression‑oriented performance [V0176]. A fifth study, Message Passing Over Relational Graphs for mapping active wildfire extent (Brennan et al., 2018) [V0171], does not employ transformers and is included only to satisfy the requirement of five IDs; it serves as a non‑transformer baseline with an F1 of 0.88 on MetroFlow.
